parameters.name: BackupId
parameters.description: The ID of the backup to query.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end time of the backup query. Format: yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm.

parameters.name: EndTimeUTC
parameters.description: The end time of the backup query in UTC. The end time must be later than the start time. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start time of the backup query. Format: yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm.

parameters.name: StartTimeUTC
parameters.description: The start time of the backup query in UTC. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ.
